changes: Net-change persistence journal and atomic compaction on reload
CPU shared-memory activity channel without persistent heartbeat writes
Keep upstream COPY length handling with empty, range, alignment and cached-resource guards
Preserve legacy REF view end-boundary behavior for QAQR compatibility
Distinguish compatible resource reuse from creation failure so repeated buffer and texture copies keep executing
Convert structured compute output to valid plain vertex/index buffers for ShapeKey menus, preserving out-of-band stride and failure guards

Share one GPU resource between [Resource] sections whose files are identical (share_duplicate_resources, default on; written, render target, UAV and pool resources keep their own copy), ported from the Vulkan branch

A config reload keeps the GPU resource of every [Resource] file that is unchanged (same file ID, size, write and change time) and loaded the same way, instead of reading and uploading every Mod again; resources of renamed-away, changed or unused files are released
A config reload with unchanged ShaderRegex sections relinks each shader's matched groups and reuses its patched shader instead of reading the cache files and creating it again
The ShaderRegex cache hash covers whole lines (lengths were in characters, not bytes), so editing the end of a pattern or replacement no longer keeps a stale cached patch

Faster config parsing with identical results: ini files read in one go with the old stream's decoding rules, ASCII case folding without per-character locale lookups, and the command list optimiser collapsing else-if chains in one pass
validation: Isolated D3D11 WARP processes; no game is launched or injected
